text: Maria Chen: Heads-up — CobaltEdge marketplace listing aims to go live Thursday EOD. Need final asset passback: logo (SVG + PNG), alt text, one‑paragraph customer quote (BetaCorp), and the 1‑pager PDF. Draft folder here: https://drive.redwood/cobaltedge-marketplace-draft Jack Rivera: On it. Quick Q — which lockup do they prefer? They sent stacked + horizontal variants. Maria Chen: Use horizontal for the marketplace tile, stacked ok for case study header. Drive has both. Also included partner brand guidelines (pdf). Leah Patel: We should scrub the quote for PII. Proposed: "BetaCorp reduced inference latency by ~40% using CobaltEdge + Redwood" — ok? Nina Gomez: Legal note — please avoid exact customer metrics unless we have written BetaCorp sign-off. Suggest "significant reduction in latency" as fallback. @Maria can you confirm the sign-off process? Devon Brooks: BetaCorp AE said they already approved the metric in an email thread. I'll fetch the screenshot and drop it in the folder. Jack Rivera: Design check: alt text suggestion for diagrams: `CobaltEdge and Redwood Inference integrated architecture diagram serving models at the edge`. Any preference for shorter alt? Maria Chen: Shorter alt OK: "CobaltEdge logo with Redwood badge — joint edge model serving solution" RileyBot: Auto-brand check: CobaltEdge primary yellow in provided assets is #FFB800 but partner kit lists #FFC900. Flagging color mismatch. :robot_face: Leah Patel: Partner confirmed their current preferred hex is #FFB800 (they requested a warmer tone). Marketing is fine with the deviation if brand team approves. Nina Gomez: Legal needs signed trademark/logo usage waiver uploaded before we publish. Please attach to the drive (legal_signoff.pdf). Devon Brooks: Attached AE email screenshot (2026-03-17) confirming metrics — file: beta-email-screenshot.png Maria Chen: Cool. Plan: Jack, export horizontal SVG + 2x PNGs and drop into `assets/final/` by 5pm PT? Also update one‑pager with the approved quote or fallback phrasing. :clock5: Jack Rivera: Yep — will export and add the marketplace badge (per cloud spec). Quick snippet for devs: `````` Leah Patel: :thumbsup: I'll prep the marketplace metadata (category: Edge inference; tags: latency, quantization, on‑prem) and the publish checklist. deploy-bot: preview listing deployed to staging: https://staging.marketplace.redwood/cobaltedge — preview expires in 48h Maria Chen: Last item — homepage pullquote for the joint campaign. Proposed options: 1) "40% latency reduction" (numeric) or 2) "Major latency and cost improvements" (non-numeric). Thoughts? Nina Gomez: If we use the numeric tile we must reference BetaCorp permission. Otherwise choose the non-numeric line. Devon Brooks: AE gave explicit OK for the latency number in the screenshot I uploaded. Recommend using the numeric latency stat on the tile, and non-numeric for broader copy. Maria Chen: Great — proceeding with numeric tile and non-numeric supporting copy. I will close the thread once final assets + legal waiver are in the drive. Thanks everyone.
